description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for auditing task flow records, including detecting stale states, missing linked tasks, timestamp inconsistencies, and summarizing findings.

methods.name: createFinding
methods.description: Creates a TaskFlowAuditFinding object with specified parameters.

methods.name: severityRank
methods.description: Returns a numeric rank for severity levels, with 'error' as 0 and 'warn' as 1.

methods.name: compareFindings
methods.description: Compares two audit findings based on severity, age, and creation time for sorting.

methods.name: getReferenceAt
methods.description: Returns the reference timestamp for a flow, prioritizing 'updatedAt' over 'createdAt'.

methods.name: getLinkedTasks
methods.description: Retrieves tasks linked to a flow ID using an external function.

methods.name: hasBlockingMetadata
methods.description: Checks if a flow has blocking metadata such as blocked task ID, summary, or wait JSON.

methods.name: findTimestampInconsistency
methods.description: Detects timestamp inconsistencies in a flow, such as 'updatedAt' before 'createdAt' or 'endedAt' before 'createdAt'.
